:= by
  let f_seq_s := ⋃ (f' ∈ f) (f' '' s)
  let h_image : ∀ f' ∈ f, (f' '' s).Finite := λ f' hf', Set.Finite.image f' hs

    Set.Finite.union_finite_iff_finite_finite.fst
      (Set.Finite.of_finite_union (hf.map h_image))
